info.description:
# Giga API — Search

Generated **2026-08-18** from the live production gateway. Every request here was actually sent to
`https://giga-giga-production.up.railway.app` with the QA logins; the description on each request
records the HTTP status it really returned.

**Setup:** run `Auth & User → Login (Customer)` and `Login (Admin)` first — they populate
`{{token}}` and `{{adminToken}}`.

Requests marked 🔴 are known defects, cross-referenced to `docs/API_VERIFICATION_2026-08-18.md`.
Their tests assert the *current broken* status so the suite stays green until someone fixes them —
flip the assertion when you do.

⚠️ **Never send a literal `{}` JSON body** — it hangs the gateway forever (defect V3).
